name: What is the process of optimizing existing pest control website content for AEO?

mainEntity.name: What is the process of optimizing existing pest control website content for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Optimizing existing content for AEO involves several steps. First, identify pages with high potential based on current traffic or relevance to common questions. Then, rewrite or add sections to directly answer specific questions concisely, using clear headings and bullet points. Incorporate relevant long-tail keywords and question phrases naturally within the text. Implement schema markup (structured data) to explicitly tell search engines what your content is about and what questions it answers. Finally, ensure your content is up-to-date, accurate, and easy to read on all devices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Optimize existing content by identifying high-potential pages, rewriting sections to directly answer questions, using long-tail keywords, implementing schema markup, and ensuring readability and accuracy.
